column1: # survey: Custom Rates for 2024 Wisconsin Farm Operations (2024 Wisconsin Custom Rate Survey)
# publisher: University of Wisconsin-Madison Division of Extension
# collected: Online survey launched March 2025; 161 respondents who performed, hired or knew 2024 custom rates in Wisconsin
# includes: The custom rates reported in this survey include fuel cost unless otherwise stated. Average is the simple average of all reported rates; Range is the minimum and maximum reported values.

# range_note: The range is the lowest and highest answer. Rows whose unit or grouping the report leaves unclear (the baling lines in the forage table, the seeding sub-rows and the first corn harvest line) are left out.
